payload.reason: The evidence provides specific hyperparameters that were explored in the context of word2vec models, including dimension size, training epochs, window size, and vocabulary size.

claims.text: The hyperparameters explored include vector dimension size, training epochs, window size, and vocabulary size.
The dimension size was varied from 50 to 1,000 dimensions, and vocabulary sizes from 30,000 to 3,000,000.
The study also examined the impact of subsampling rate on the quality of word vectors.
